purpose: Estimate the replicate-level SD of the paired Delta R2_genetic on the exact bound frozen contract, then map it to the Gate 0A replicate count R. Estimates variance ONLY; decides no winner.

requires_before_run.note: run is refused unless BINDING.json status == BOUND and the exported panel matches the contract

estimand: SD(Delta_r), Delta_r = R2_genetic(A_test=kpca_rbf) - R2_genetic(B_pca_z), per (regime, k) cell
primary_metric_is_heritability_independe: R2_genetic fits the downstream to the noise-free genetic value g, so its replicate SD does not depend on h2; the pilot needs no h2 grid (h2 enters only the secondary R2_pheno used in Gate 0A reporting, not here)

representative_regimes.spectral_tail_adversarial: MUST include; the primary gating regime

outer_folds_drawn_once: the outer 5-fold split is drawn once over the training population and shared byte-identically across all regimes, budgets, arms, and replicates
trained_on: donor-train only (2247); the 249 donor-validation rows are never touched by the pilot
replicate_is_one_fixed_trait: each replicate draws g_r once; the same g_r is predicted across all outer folds (g does not change per fold)
polygenic_background_note: each regime's g = sqrt(1-frac)*named_component + sqrt(frac)*diffuse_polygenic, matching the rc2 DGP which requires a diffuse polygenic background in every regime

eval_block_subset.note: for additive regimes the downstream reads a bounded set of blocks to keep the pilot affordable; the chosen block set is recorded in the results so Gate 0A can match it. If set to null, all blocks are used.

replicate_count_rule.map: sigma_hat -> required R via the detectability procedure (percentile bootstrap CI lower>0) at the FIXED margin 0.005 and target power 0.90
replicate_count_rule.R_formal: max over the pre-registered primary-relevant cells of required R; NEVER the average -- size to the hardest regime so spectral_tail is not under-powered
replicate_count_rule.underpowered: if no candidate R suffices at the pinned sigma, increase R; never lower the 0.005 margin

firewall_results_may_not_decide: whether a DGP regime is retained
